name: Singju
subtitle: manipur's raw-vegetable salad bound with roasted gram flour and loud with chilli

ingredients.qty: 250g, shredded as finely as you can manage

ingredients.note: dry-roasted; this is the binder that makes singju singju
stands in for thoiding, the perilla seed used in Manipur, which the catalogue does not carry. Roast and grind it the same way
for ngari, the fermented fish; roast and crumble it

prepNotes: Shred the cabbage on the day and keep it dry. Washed and not spun out, the water thins the gram flour and the salad slumps.
Roast the besan, sesame, chilli and dried fish ahead. All four can be done in the same pan, in that order, in under ten minutes.
Dress it at the last minute. Singju is assembled to be eaten within about twenty minutes.

steps.text: Dry-roast the besan over low heat for 4 minutes, stirring constantly, until it turns a shade darker and smells nutty. Tip it straight out of the pan.
steps.tip: It goes from nutty to burnt in about fifteen seconds at the end. Do not walk away.

steps.text: Roast the sesame in the same pan 2 minutes until the seeds start popping, then grind them coarsely.
Roast the dried red chillies 40 seconds a side until they darken, and pound them coarse.
Roast the dried fish 3 minutes over low heat until brittle, then crumble it fine.
Toss the cabbage, radish and spring onion in a wide bowl with the salt and leave 5 minutes.
Squeeze the vegetables gently with your hands and pour off any water that has come out.
steps.tip: This is the step people skip, and it is why home singju often goes soggy.

steps.text: Scatter over the roasted besan, ground sesame, crumbled fish and pounded chilli, and mix with your fingers until every shred is coated and the flour has stopped looking powdery.
Add the lemon juice and coriander, toss once more and serve immediately as a side or an evening snack.

storage: Eat within the hour. The gram flour draws water and the salad wilts. The roasted besan, sesame, chilli and fish keep a week in an airtight jar, so make that mix ahead and shred the cabbage fresh.

nutrition.method: Estimated from raw ingredients using USDA FoodData Central. Cooking losses are not modelled and added salt is excluded, so sodium is not given.
nutrition.caveat: Ingredients given to taste rather than by weight are counted as zero, so the real figure is a little higher than this. The + says so.
